how_to_change: The source owner approves a new or changed label or rule by merging a pull request that edits this file, then regenerates or updates etl/03_silver/04_clean_psa_psgc.sql and 90_validate_psa_psgc_clean.sql (docs/operations/silver.md). A label that is not listed here fails the Silver gate (labels_mapped_*); it is never accepted silently. No code or category is guessed (#88).
evidence_basis: Counts below are from psa_psgc_raw, current batch psa_psgc__2026-Q2__31892bc2bdde (43,768 rows), loaded locally from main c873717 on 2026-10-09, and agree with the profile (docs/data/source-inventory/psa_psgc/profile.md).

identifier.note: Kept as text with its leading zeros (29,620 codes start with 0, e.g. Region IX is 0900000000). Validated exactly as published, without trimming. A blank or malformed code quarantines the row. A repeated code quarantines every copy and FAILs the gate, so nothing is published: PSGC is what Integration joins to (D-019). 0 rows in the 2Q 2026 delivery.

correspondence_code.rule: Kept as text with its leading zeros. Blank becomes NULL and is never derived from psgc_code. A filled value that is not nine digits quarantines the row.
correspondence_code.evidence: 43,718 filled, all nine digits and unique; 50 blank (barangays 38, municipalities 8, provinces 2, blank level 1, region 1: Maguindanao del Norte and del Sur, the Negros Island Region, and the Special Geographic Area). S-2 (an older 9-digit PSGC kept for continuity) is supported but not confirmed by PSA.

name.rule: Trim, and collapse runs of spaces, tabs, and no-break spaces to one space. Spelling is not otherwise changed. The published value stays in Bronze.
name.evidence: 2,855 names end in a space (2,846 of them on rows with a Status value); 0 leading or double spaces. Names are not keys: 27,391 distinct names in 43,768 rows.

old_names.rule: Same whitespace rule as name. Blank becomes NULL. Used for matching older sources, not as a full history.
old_names.evidence: 1,699 rows filled (barangays 1,618, municipalities 75, cities 3, provinces 3); 3 end in a space.

column_j_footnote.reason: Column J has no header in the workbook and holds footnotes about the population figure, not data. The new name says what it annotates.
column_j_footnote.rule: Kept as text (whitespace rule as name); blank becomes NULL. Kept in Silver because a province's population excludes the cities named here, which Gold must know before summing.
column_j_footnote.evidence: 19 rows: provinces 16, regions 2, barangays 1. 16 are '(excluding CITY OF ...)' notes (one names Cebu, Lapu-Lapu, and Mandaue) and 3 are the markers '1/', '2/', '3/'.

population.rule: Cast to nullable INT when the value is one or more digits. The publisher's '#N/A' becomes NULL with population_null_reason = 'publisher_na'. Zero stays 0 (a published value, flagged for review, never treated as missing). Any other value quarantines the row as population_uncastable. A blank population becomes NULL with population_null_reason = 'blank' and is counted (rule_population_blank_to_null); 0 rows in 2Q 2026.

#N/A.evidence: 1 row: 0990100000 'City of Isabela (Not a Province)' (blank level). The City of Isabela itself, 0990101000, has its population.

population.zero_evidence: 12 rows, all barangays. Flagged as population_is_zero.
population.range_evidence: Largest values by level: region 16,933,234; province 4,573,884; city 3,084,270; municipality 451,383; sub-municipality 637,942; barangay 215,035. All fit INT.

reconciliation.note: The difference is the Filipinos abroad stated in the Notes sheet (D.2), so the 18 regions must sum to 112,727,776, never to the national figure (O-4).

income_classification.rule: Split into income_class (the class without the star) and income_class_retained_after_downgrade (TRUE when the published class has a star, FALSE for an unstarred class, NULL when there is no class). '-' becomes NULL with income_class_null_reason = 'not_classified'. Blank stays NULL (not classified at that level).

labels.evidence: The 8 Special Geographic Area municipalities (1999901000 to 1999908000).

income_classification.open_question: The star's meaning ('retained after downgrade') follows the profile's proposed handling (O-7); the Notes sheet does not define it. UNVERIFIED until PSA or the mentor confirms; the published value stays in Bronze.

geographic_level.rule: Kept as published (PSA's abbreviations). Blank becomes NULL and is flagged (level_blank); no level is assigned without a reviewed rule (open decision below). The Notes legend lists Dist, which has 0 rows, and omits City, so the standard set is the observed values.

labels.evidence: 14 rows, all under 1380600000 City of Manila.

blank.evidence: 0990100000 'City of Isabela (Not a Province)' and 1999900000 'Special Geographic Area'. Both sit at the province position of the code and hold units below them: 0990100000 holds the City of Isabela (0990101000, City, CC) and its 45 barangays; 1999900000 holds the 8 Special Geographic Area municipalities and their 63 barangays.

city_class.finding: Bronze (no profile finding; values counted for this mapping)
city_class.rule: Kept as published. Filled only for cities; blank elsewhere stays NULL.

labels.evidence: 33 cities. None has a province row above it: the province position of the code is the city itself.

urban_rural.rule: Kept as published for U and R. '-' becomes NULL with urban_rural_null_reason = 'unknown' and is never folded into rural. Blank (every row that is not a barangay) stays NULL.

labels.evidence: 38 barangays, exactly the 38 barangays with a blank correspondence_code (S-1: likely created after the 2020 census). Includes 6 Caloocan barangays, so not every NCR barangay is U.

status.rule: Kept as published; blank stays NULL. The meaning of each value is not defined by PSA (S-5).

hierarchy.rule: Silver adds the parent codes derived from psgc_code (it never changes psgc_code): region_code = first 2 digits + 8 zeros; province_code = first 5 digits + 5 zeros when that code is a Prov row or one of the two blank-level containers, else NULL; city_municipality_code = first 7 digits + 3 zeros for barangays. The gate asserts every derived parent exists in the same delivery.

evidence.region: Every non-region row's region_code is a Reg row (0 missing).
evidence.province: Provinces' region exists (0 missing). Of cities and municipalities, those without a Prov row at the province position are: the 33 HUCs (the position is the city itself), Pateros (NCR, no province), the City of Isabela (under the 0990100000 container), and the 8 Special Geographic Area municipalities (under the 1999900000 container).
evidence.city_municipality: Every barangay's city_municipality_code exists: municipality 34,007, city 7,106, sub-municipality 897 (Manila).
evidence.sub_municipality: The 14 sub-municipalities' province position is 1380600000 City of Manila.
evidence.manila: Manila's 897 barangays have city_municipality_code = one of the 14 sub-municipalities (1380601000 to 1380614000), not the City of Manila (1380600000, an HUC, so no province_code). A sub-municipality rolls up to Manila by its first 5 digits + 00000.

no_province_exceptions.name: Pateros
no_province_exceptions.reason: The only municipality of NCR, which has no provinces (O-10). Listed so the gate can tell it from a missing province row.

hierarchy.no_province_rule: A city or municipality with no province_code must be an HUC (city_class) or listed in no_province_exceptions; anything else FAILs the gate (province_code_missing_only_where_listed), because it means a province row is missing.
hierarchy.self_reference: A region row's region_code is its own code, and so is the province_code of a province row and of the two blank-level containers. Group by these columns with care: a province's own row is in its own group.

population_is_zero.note: All barangays. A published 0, kept as 0.

has_population_footnote.note: population_footnote is filled; a province's population then excludes the named cities.

quarantine_reasons.note: No row of the 2Q 2026 delivery meets any reason. Quarantine above 0 rows of a batch is WARN and above 1% is FAIL, as for enrollment (D-024). A duplicated code also FAILs the gate on its own (D-019).

gate_expectations.note: Counts of the 2Q 2026 delivery, used by the tests of the real load. The gate does not hardcode them: it reconciles each batch with its own Bronze rows.

excluded_from_silver.note: Nothing is dropped. Every Bronze column reaches Silver (column_j_footnote renamed, income_classification split), and every Bronze row is in the clean or the quarantine table.

open_decisions.topic: Level of the two blank-level rows
open_decisions.options: Keep geographic_level NULL with level_blank (proposed, since #88 says no category is guessed), or assign a team-approved level such as a province-equivalent container, with the evidence in categories.geographic_level.blank.

open_decisions.topic: Meaning of the starred income class
open_decisions.options: Keep the split with retained_after_downgrade marked UNVERIFIED (proposed), or keep the starred label unsplit until PSA confirms.

open_decisions.topic: PSGC as the barangay population source
open_decisions.effect: population in this table is the barangay population used downstream; the barangay workbooks stay a cross-check.

correspondence_code stays a clean nine-digit string here; Integration may join old 9-digit codes through it, one-to-one and name-checked, with match_method = correspondence_code (D-029). The 50 rows without it match by name only.

master_reference: Silver flags rows of the quarter named by master_reference_period in config/ingestion/psa_psgc.json (2026-Q2, D-012) as is_master_reference; every current quarter is kept.
